status: DRAFT - not ratified, not consumed by anything
purpose: The single declaration from which a county's profile record, the preflight gate, the bake's output list, the grader's required-leaf list and the rail gate's unaccounted set are all DERIVED. Today those are four hand-grown lists and the gaps between them are where every expensive defect of 2026-08 and 2026-09 lived.
governing_ruling: _decisions/2026-09-01_every_parcel_starts_with_a_full_record.md - a record is instantiated with its complete column set; acquisition changes a cell's STATE, never its EXISTENCE. This file applies that ruling one level up, to counties.
derivation_note: Columns marked basis=evidenced exist because a NAMED failure in the six Central Texas counties made them necessary. Columns marked basis=inferred are proposed by reasoning and have not yet cost anything. Review the inferred ones hardest.

cellStates.unaccounted: Nobody has looked. Legitimate at rest, fatal at publish. The default at instantiation.
cellStates.value: Measured. Carries instrument, scope and timestamp.
cellStates.absent-verified: Something looked and it is not there. Requires a named instrument and an explicit scope. NEVER written to clear a gate.
cellStates.not-applicable: A ruling says this column does not govern this county. Requires a decision-record pointer.
cellStates.refused: A real value exists upstream and the source cannot say which. Weaker than not-applicable. Used where not-applicable would make a false claim about the world.
cellStates.available-on-request: This rail is not acquired in bulk; it is fetched per parcel on demand through a NAMED, REACHABLE request path, and nobody has requested it for this parcel. NOT an absence claim - it says nothing about whether the fact exists. Requires requestPath. A requestPath that is not reachable is not this state. Ruled 2026-09-10, _decisions/2026-09-10_available_on_request_sixth_cell_state.md.

stateRules: Every state other than unaccounted carries instrument, scope and measuredAt. A state with no instrument is unaccounted regardless of what it says.

unaccounted -> absent-verified requires a named instrument that actually ran. A relabelling tripwire counts unaccounted falling without a matching acquisition landing (per _decisions/2026-09-08_zoning_unaccounted_two_populations.md).
Where a real limit exists and the source cannot say which, the state is refused, not not-applicable. Default to the weaker state. Evidence: Austin watershed classes, 2026-09-09 operator ruling.
A column's state is never inferred from a sibling column's state.
Scope is mandatory on absent-verified. 'Absent' with no scope is the fabricated-zero shape.

available-on-request requires a named, REACHABLE requestPath. A dead path is unaccounted or refused, never a promise the product cannot keep. Adding a rail to this state is a ruling, never a lane's discretion.

scopes.rail: One cell per county per rail.
scopes.city: One cell per county per city in the roster.

columns.why: Store identity. A wrong-db or wrong-county query returns a FALSE absence, not an error.
A CRS mismatch produces a silent 0-match on a full stamp run rather than an error.
columns.evidence: memory/zoning-coverage-is-wired-city-not-data.md - 'Watch for the San-Marcos-style CRS/centroid 0-match on a big city (would waste a full re-bake)'

columns.why: assertTexasWgs84Bbox throws per feature on any non-Texas coordinate, so a second state fails closed on row one. The assertion's domain must be a declared county property, not a hardcoded constant.
Instantiation timestamp. Needed to compute time-to-production and to detect records created retroactively to look complete.

parcel_record is drawn from the StratMap parcel layer, not the CAD account population. Confirmed at row level. A parcel is not an account and conflating them produced a near-miss retirement write on 38,060 rows.
OPS-1 freshness flags: county-ArcGIS overrides TxGIO staged bulk where fresher. Which one governs must be declared, not chosen at run time.
The Bastrop registry row flags its own geometry vintage STALE (202503) and the run proceeded anyway, because vintage was a note rather than a gate.

THE FOUNDING CASE. The Harris TxGIO archive ships two shapefiles. discoverShapefile uses files.find(), which returns the first match and discards the rest with no count and no warning. The 213 MB west half was downloaded, extracted and silently dropped. Four instruments then agreed the county was fine.
Harris loaded 536,512 against an expected 564,948 and no instrument noticed, because a count cannot detect a defect it inherits.

The short load produced an artificial western wall at lon -95.4364 with 21,300 parcels stacked against it, while true Harris extends to about -95.96. A measured bbox compared against the county's declared extent is a second derivation that a row count cannot fake.
Parcel identity churns across reloads: Hays 30.5 percent gone and 19.5 percent drifted, Bastrop zero across 400 samples. Healthy-looking aggregates mask it because new parcels backfill the count.

The 2026-09-03 StratMap reload replaced every parcel row in all six counties and dropped the derived zoning stamp, leaving zoning_district NULL on 1,516,110 parcels. The baked snapshot rows were the ONLY surviving copy and the bake lane has no monotonic guard, so a bake would have overwritten the last copy with nulls.
columns.evidence: 00_current_state.md P-124 Wave 1 block; Comal 48091 held as an unreloaded control

columns.why: The parcel-node planner folds every feature sharing one prop_id into ONE atom by design, but the geometry scorer's denominator counts DISTINCT feature_index. That divides an account-cardinality numerator by a feature-cardinality denominator, so any county where an account spans multiple features can never reach 100 percent. Nine counties at 94.1-94.99 percent are FULLY WRITTEN and mis-scored.

On 2026-08-25 someone needed Hays coverage, the CAD export was short, so they padded cad_property with 116,421 StratMap geometry rows and overwrote source_file IN PLACE. Locally rational, invisible for five weeks, then cost two full lanes, a false alarm about an appraisal district, and nearly a recordRetirement written onto 38,060 parcels that were never accounts.
OPS-2 STAGE 0 requires Rail B CAD named in a frozen registry row.

The cadRoll gate was not vintage-scoped, so Hays could only clear by relabelling 37,813 rows as having left the roll. Scoping the gate clears the county and fabricates a retirement claim; the honest fix needs the roll's vintage as a declared column.
Travis serves a systematic tenfold gap between its 2025 and 2026 value rows on four of five parcels read live. Customer-visible, live now, and not contained in any thesis about the pipeline.
OPS-1 names eight high-bad-id counties where prop_id cannot be the join key. Choosing at run time is how a wrong join reaches production.
Bastrop measured 0.0022 and the prop_id join was therefore fine. The rate must be measured before the join key is chosen, not after the run fails.

Ector 48135's prop_id column is not an account id at all. Values are numeric quantities like 0.00000000 and 1576.00000000, an acreage or value column mis-mapped into the prop_id slot at ingest. 75,891 features collapse to 3,791 atoms, 5.00 percent, and it reads as a coverage problem.

isUsableKeyToken tests /^0+$/ on the trimmed string, which does NOT match '0.00000000' because the decimal defeats it. 2,974 Ector features fabricated a shared account instead of becoming typed parcel-key-unresolved absences. A guard whose predicate does not cover the county's actual value domain is a fabrication path.

The readiness gate refused Williamson at 46.9 and Caldwell at 51.4 percent for a defect that did not exist: parcel_record's intended population is landing_parcel_jurisdiction, not the cad_property ACCOUNT roll. Measured as real id-set intersections the two match EXACTLY in all six counties. The measurement was wrong, not the data.
columns.evidence: 00_current_state.md P-124 Wave 2 block; commit c59965e, PR #101, proven by violation with Dallas and Tarrant

columns.why: baseFacts.situsState was a bare null on 312,169 parcels because the bake read it off the join with ?? null and cad_property HAS NO situs_state COLUMN AT ALL. A declared column inventory turns that from a four-hour discovery into a preflight refusal.

A paying customer opening a McLennan parcel is served market, land and improvement dollars labelled county-assessed, byte-identical in label to a Travis value from the appraisal district's own export. The label is a pair of string constants and the tier is dropped at the next seam. This is a provenance-labelling defect, and the proposed absence state would have deleted values a customer can legitimately use if labelled.
columns.evidence: _inbox/2026-09-10_ctx_third_party_review.md; ruling e924cb5c 'provenance is a label not an absence'

columns.why: Names which upstream column the address is read from, so a sentinel can be attributed rather than guessed at.

THE LARGEST MEASURED DEFECT IN THE PROGRAM. Bastrop serves the literal ', ,'. Travis serves ', TX 78756' - a real ZIP, no street, coverage claiming populated. The existing guard matches pure punctuation only, so the second shape walks straight through. Census across six counties found about 170,840 defective rows, and three counties that PASSED their walks were carrying it: Caldwell passed on an 86-parcel sample while holding 15,289 bare nulls, Bastrop 2,988, McLennan 696.

Statewide, situs_address IS NOT NULL gives 99.45 percent and carries-a-street-segment gives 89.90 percent. 1,248,412 parcels count as populated and carry no street. The presence-shaped rule counted a string being present and never counted an address being present.
situsState is derivable from countyFips and is not present in the source. Which fields are derived versus sourced must be declared, or a derived field reads as missing data.
Caldwell is held until retired payloads bake situs null and bucket ids leave the walk cohort. A retired parcel carrying a live-shaped situs payload is graded as a live parcel with a bad address.

Until 2026-08-11 every row in the Texas roster had parent_county_fips NULL, so no city-scoped plan was executable. Now 1,214 of 1,223 are linked and the six CTX counties hold 72 cities, not the 9 previously assumed.

Zoning coverage is WIRED-CITY coverage, not data availability. A parcel gets a stamp only if it falls inside a wired city's layer. Austin was genuinely ABSENT from the ZONING_LAYERS registry while Travis coverage was being read as a data problem.
Elgin's polygons were never staged into the table the rail actually reads. Blocker eleven, and it blocked both Bastrop and Travis. Wired in a registry is not the same as staged in the table.

San Antonio IS wired and under-stamps at about 0.37 percent, half of it an OCL null-rule that should not stamp a district at all. A dry-run match rate on a sample before stamping millions of parcels is the difference between a wasted full re-bake and a five-minute refusal.

First of two INDEPENDENTLY DERIVED measurements behind the completeness declaration: the share of in-city parcels carrying a real district cell, read from parcel_record_cell, which is the population the readiness gate actually scores.

Second measurement, from a DIFFERENT upstream: share of the city-limits polygon area covered by zoning polygons, computed in PostGIS from tx_zoning_district_staging against tx_city_boundary. Two upstreams means no single source can satisfy both halves. This is the meaning-shaped check the enforcement doctrine asks for.

Without it, a parcel matching no polygon is indistinguishable from a hole in our own copy of the layer. 5,876 unaccounted in-city parcels across six counties were THE WHOLE BLOCKER on the bake because this artifact existed nowhere in the stack. 22 cities are now declared; the rest are undeclared, which is a legitimate state and must not be silently read as complete.

Setback follows zoning by design because the setback rule cites the district, EXCEPT where the city has no setback table transcribed. San Antonio's san-antonio-tx.json is owed, so a big-city zoning fix raises zoning percent without raising setback percent and that reads as a regression.

Unincorporated Texas county land is LEGITIMATELY unzoned, so no-zoning-stamp there is correct and 100 percent zoning coverage is not the target and never will be. Without a declared ruling this reads as the largest gap in the county.

Of Austin's five watershed classes only WATER SUPPLY SUBURBAN resolves. URBAN and WATER SUPPLY RURAL earn not-applicable because the ordinance says the rail does not govern those parcels; SUBURBAN and BSZ earn refused because a real limit exists and the source cannot say which. Two different absence states inside one rail in one city.
OPS-8 pre-flight check 1: source plus adapter reachable, or the rail declines by name up front rather than 403-ing mid-run.
Named in a registry means named, not proven working. The ecode360-scraper was in the registry with zero demonstrated successful ingests anywhere in the doc set or code history.

county_rail.has_writer and atomFamilyState are HAND-DECLARED, not derived from code, and migration 0068:20-26 says outright that updating the column does not wire a writer. Verified drift in BOTH directions on 2026-08-11: up to 762 cells rendered as unstarted work that was actually built. countyLedger.ts:198 gives has_writer=false ABSOLUTE precedence, so a stale declaration silently overrides real engine state on all 254 cells of a rail.

NOTHING TODAY DISTINGUISHES REGISTERED FROM CAN-PRODUCE-COVERAGE. All five 2026-08 rails are registered in PROPERTY_ENTITY_TYPES, so a manifest driven off registration shows five green rails when one covered a single county, one cannot finish a metro county on its complexity, and one could not verify its own writes.

parcel-r5-zoning held a CLI command AND a Cloud Run guard AND no Cloud Run job, so its --apply path could not execute anywhere. Dispatchable is a third distinct level from registered and from deployed.

buildLayerGapCells merged in 759da08 called by nothing, committed hours after the planner built the control for that exact class. The existing control checks that writer JOBS are CLI-dispatchable and says nothing about a function inside a job having a call site.
A writer whose verify step cannot fail reports success on a no-op. Fixed for all six writers in PR #306; the column exists so the next writer cannot ship without it.

A rail that is live in one county and registered statewide reads as statewide capability. RRC wells was Harris-only while registered like the rest; it is now genuinely 254 counties, which is why the COLUMN and not the value is the lesson.
The scorer's denominator is a declared choice and getting it wrong looks exactly like missing data. Fix the denominator, never the writer.

CTX-STAMP was dispatched at the wrong repo, read the function it was pointed at, found it wrote a DIFFERENT TABLE IN A DIFFERENT DATABASE, and stopped rather than ship a no-op. The only pointer to the right target was a code comment.

THE MECHANISM BEHIND THE WHOLE CLASS. situsAddress is required by the grader and owned by nobody at the bake. It sits in the gap between the bake's output list and the grader's required-leaf list, and both lists are hand-grown one leaf per lane. This column is the single declaration both lists must derive from.
columns.evidence: planner account of the CTX-B3 census scoping error, 2026-09-10

columns.why: Six fact families reach NO consumer, invariant across four counties, measured on the serving revision by two seats independently: utilities, dischargePoint, floodplainAcreage, firmPanel, soil, electricProvider. Three of them were merged as engine PR #404 - built, tested, and reaching nobody. Separately, tier2 flood reaches no user because mergeBakedBaseFacts drops tier2 and two flood stores disagree.

Every LDT merge requires a factory pin bump and a rebuild before it reaches the bake, and the only mechanism holding that seam is the planner noticing. It failed on 2026-09-09: CTX-SITUS-SKIP merged, the pin stayed at 3885efad, and Caldwell and McLennan both failed on a fix that was merged and unreachable.

The meaning-shaped version of the pin check, and its instrument already exists: CTX-PIN wrote a module-graph tracer over the 26-module bake graph and validated it by reproducing a known answer. Fail only when a commit between the pin and main touches a file INSIDE the graph. A naive check that fires on any divergence is over-broad and teaches the fleet to use the bypass flag.
columns.evidence: planner seam account 2026-09-10; ENFORCEMENT.md over-broad-control rule

columns.why: CTX-PIN reported that nothing validates _LDT_SHA is even a real 40-character SHA. A malformed pin sails through. Cheap, separate, and should exist regardless.

cortex-api's staging tag never followed the production shift, so every staging walk kept reading the pre-mirror revision. It could not simply be repointed either, because that revision read the production DB.
The atoms store is on Neon database hauska_mcp. A query against the wrong database returns a FALSE ABSENCE, not an error, which is the worst possible failure mode for an instrument.

A new revision is not a serving revision. The image a revision runs is its DIGEST, not the tag that was requested, and traffic must be read from JSON by field name because a positional value() formatter shifts every column after a blank field. The planner reported the wrong serving revision to the operator twice on one such misread.
columns.evidence: ENFORCEMENT.md 'the instrument that produced a claim'; memory/cloud-run-traffic-trap.md

columns.why: Caldwell reached PRODUCTION on a walk that drew 60 street-local parcels, all 60 clean, in a county where 38,442 would have failed. The gate passed because the instrument could not fail. A sampled verdict certifies counties that are broken on any leaf the sample did not happen to draw.

A street-local sampler makes any rail that varies by jurisdiction sample all-or-nothing. The stratified cohort added on 2026-09-09 surfaced six more bare-null required leaves in a SINGLE run that serial discovery would have found one at a time.

classifyRequiredLeaf passed any UNRECOGNISED declared state as a populated value. 25 of 25 Caldwell zoning rails graded 'value' while 3 of them were absences. A classifier that admits what it cannot interpret is a fabrication path wearing a check's name.

envelope is stripped on the serve by design (anti-zombie, WDLL 3.7) and the walk demanded a four-state there, so BP-CONTENT-01 could not pass for ANY county. The fix was stricter, not looser: a declared serve-stripped leaf must be EXACTLY null, so a resurfaced zombie now fails.

ENFORCEMENT.md: a check observed only passing has not been observed working. The 2026-08-31 GoHighLevel probe is the cautionary instance - the first two runs were VACUOUS, real and bogus returning byte-identical scope errors, and only the third separated them.
columns.evidence: ENFORCEMENT.md 'verify a check by violating it'; OPS-16 A-064

columns.why: SC-3's measured half. About 0.34 dollars for 6,972 Bastrop parcels, clearing the 200 dollar gate by orders of magnitude.

THE KILL SWITCH IS ARMED ON THE CHEAP HALF. SC-3 is graded UNENFORCED as a mechanism because the cost step is a runbook instruction an operator executes, not a gate that blocks a warm. The program is at six counties, well past the three-county hard-kill checkpoint, and the checkpoint never fired because the dimension that blew out has no instrument on it.

PROPOSED as the scalability instrument. New columns this county forced into the contract. Falling toward zero means the machine is converging and a wave can be planned. Staying flat means the contract is wrong and running more counties will not fix it. Nothing measures this today and no failure has yet demanded it.

Every publish lands on staging before the identical job runs on production, per the Factory model law. The addition here is that staging must be CENSUS-clean, not walk-clean, on the same pin as the production run.

Production publish writes live rows, the freshness stamp and a SUCCEEDED status BEFORE the walk runs, and there is no unpublish. That ordering makes the production walk a post-mortem rather than a gate, and it is the single most consequential unarmed thing in the pipeline.
columns.evidence: _inbox/2026-09-10_ctx_third_party_review.md; planner 'the one thing I will stop for', 2026-09-10

columns.why: PROPOSED. CODE-DONE is not CUSTOMER-DONE and the standing rule already says a grade is a live probe on the deployed surface across multiple different-data parcels. This column makes the probe a recorded per-county cell rather than a habit. It is inferred because no failure has yet been traced to its absence, though the Travis tenfold value gap and the Hays cross-parcel label leak were both found by exactly this kind of probe.
